Yes, this matches what I intended. I can act on a few chosen bookmarks, the current page, or every bookmark matching the current view and search without accidentally affecting unrelated items. Clearing the selection afterward is sensible, and a count-aware confirmation before permanent deletion is reassuring.

“Mark read” meaning Done and “Mark unread” meaning To read is exactly how I think of those states. When several items are archived, each should continue to remember its own read or unread state for restoration, as already agreed.
